description:
Run a small nonprofit or charity with 8 Excel workbooks: gifts, donors, grants, events, programs, volunteers, board and cash. One payment of 29 dollars, no subscription, no macros.

Donor-management and fundraising software is usually billed every month, often by the number of contacts. This is 29 dollars, once, for a director, founder or small team with volunteers who wants to know which gifts need a thank-you, which donors lapsed, which funder report to write first and how many months of reserve are left.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
✓ Thank every gift on time, tie banking to the bank slip and chase late pledges (promises to give, paid in instalments)
✓ Rank lapsed donors to call, write or let go
✓ Catch a restricted fund before it goes below zero and write the right funder report first
✓ Count people served, fill volunteer shifts and see your lowest cash month

WHAT IS INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS FOR ONE ORGANIZATION
1 Donor Book and Gift Log
2 Donor Growth and Major Gifts
3 Grants and Restricted Funds
4 Events and Campaigns
5 Programs and People Served
6 Volunteers and Members
7 Board and Governance
8 Budget, Cash and Annual Report
Each workbook has 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges: 144 tools and 160 tables on {pages} ready pages in all. Each part is a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data.

WHO IT IS FOR
Directors, founders, development leads, bookkeepers and board chairs of a small nonprofit with a volunteer board and few or no paid staff. A founder with volunteers and no staff can use most parts.
NOT FOR: online giving pages, payment processing, e-mail sending or apps. You type or paste your data. Donors appear as names, contact status, amounts and dates only.

HOW IT WORKS
1 Open the workbook for the job.
2 Replace the sample rows with your own.
3 Read the dashboard and use the tools.
Instructions are on the first sheet. Formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password).

FILE FORMAT
Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, built with the same engine as our published suites, which were tested in Google Sheets. No macros, no subscription.

GUARANTEE
If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

Letters and statements are records you can keep; ask your accountant what your rules need. Forecasts are your own estimate. More answers are in the FAQ below.

faq.q: Do I need special software? Does it work in Google Sheets?
faq.a: No. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, built with the same engine as our published suites, which were tested in Google Sheets. There are no macros and no subscription.

faq.q: We are a founder with volunteers and no paid staff. Is it for us?
faq.a: Yes. Most parts work without staff: the gift log, thank-yous, pledges, recurring donors, grants and reports due, events, volunteer shifts, the board roster and the cash forecast. Leave the staff time and pay rows empty or use one budget line per program.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency and date format?
faq.a: Yes. Amounts are plain numbers and you change the currency symbol in one cell. Dates follow your computer's regional format. Targets such as thank-you days, reserve months and the cost to raise one dollar are settings you edit.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Every part comes as a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data, so you can explore first and start clean. You type or paste your own gifts, grants, shifts and expenses. Instructions are on the first sheet.

faq.q: Is it a donor database, an online giving tool or tax advice?
faq.a: No. It is a set of workbooks you fill with typed or pasted data. It does not take payments, send e-mail or sync with other systems, and it gives no legal, tax or accounting advice. Ask your accountant what your own rules need.

faq.q: What if a file does not work?
faq.a: If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.
